    function stop($token) { unset($this->listeners[$token]); }
    function write($id, $text) {
        $this->records[$id] = $text;
        $event = ['id'=>$id, 'text'=>$text, 'revision'=>++$this->revision];
        foreach ($this->listeners as $token=>$fn) if (isset($this->listeners[$token])) $fn($event);
        return $event;

    private $env, $delay, $work, $handle = null, $pending = null;
    function __construct($env, $delay, $work) { $this->env=$env; $this->delay=$delay; $this->work=$work; }

        $this->pending=$value;
        $this->handle=$this->env->schedule(function() { $this->flush(); }, $this->delay);

        if ($this->handle !== null) $this->env->cancel($this->handle);

lifecycle_identity: Each select() retains a newly incremented visit identifier shared by that visit's document output, selection(), and committed projection entry.

Projection trail entries remain copied visit records and are not retroactively changed by later selection, closure, editing, or autosave.

Maintain independent pending autosave state per document so navigation between documents neither combines their edits nor redirects a delayed write.

Preserve Store::write semantics: when the delayed save occurs, it updates the addressed record, increments revision, synchronously notifies subscribed integrations, and returns the event as before.

class Preview {private $task;function __construct($env){$this->task=new Trailing($env,40,function($q)use($env){$env->output('preview',['query'=>$q]);});}function query($text){$this->task->push($text);}function hide(){$this->task->cancel();}}

class Projection {private $env,$selected=null,$trail=[];function __construct($env){$this->env=$env;}function publish(){$this->env->output('projection',['selected'=>$this->selected,'trail'=>$this->trail]);}function commit($v){$this->selected=$v;$this->trail[]=$v;$this->publish();}function clear(){$this->selected=null;$this->publish();}}

A full 120 ms interval without another edit for that same document triggers persistence of its latest pending text.
Calling Workspace::select retires the current view and opens a newly numbered visit without cancelling another document's pending autosave.
Calling Workspace::close or dispose retires the active view and clears current projection selection without cancelling document-owned pending persistence.
Store::write synchronously triggers subscribed saved integrations, which may navigate while the autosave callback is executing.

The public sources do not specify whether equal consecutive text values should be deduplicated; the stated requirement is burst coalescing, so no additional value-based deduplication is established.

The public sources do not specify an explicit final flush on process shutdown; existing per-document trailing behavior and navigation persistence should be preserved without inventing a new shutdown protocol.
The public sources do not define exception handling for scheduler, output, store, or listener callbacks; no new exception-swallowing or recovery requirement is established.
Public checks validate PHP syntax but do not establish business correctness.

checkpoints: After changing business code, run the public PHP syntax check under PHP 7.4 compatibility; this confirms syntax only, not business behavior.
Verify a burst of edits produces no immediate store write and exactly one eventual write containing the latest text after 120 ms of inactivity.
Verify pending saves remain associated with their originating document across select(), close(), and re-selection boundaries.
Verify selection, document output, projection commits, breadcrumb history, and visit identifiers retain their existing observable ordering and values.
Verify search preview still uses its existing 40 ms trailing task and hide() cancellation behavior.
forbidden_effects: Do not change search preview timing, coalescing, output shape, or cancellation behavior.
Do not merge autosave state across different document identifiers.
Do not discard a pending document save merely because the user selects another document or closes the editor.
Do not cause an autosave for an old document to overwrite or otherwise target the currently selected document.
Do not weaken synchronous Store::write notification behavior or suppress saved-integration callbacks.
Do not change navigation output ordering, projection breadcrumb retention, or visit allocation.
Do not edit tests, configuration, dependency manifests, public documentation, or evaluator artifacts.
lifecycle_identity: Each select() retains a newly incremented visit identifier shared by that visit's document output, selection(), and committed projection entry.
Autosave ownership is by document identifier through BufferBank; a delayed save must retain the identifier captured for that document rather than derive identity from Editor::$current when it fires.
Revisiting the same document reuses that document's trailing buffer, so edits within the active pending interval coalesce for that document.
Projection trail entries remain copied visit records and are not retroactively changed by later selection, closure, editing, or autosave.

obligations.text: Editor::edit must enqueue the current document's text into its existing 120 ms Trailing buffer instead of calling the workspace write operation immediately.
For multiple edits to the same document before 120 ms of inactivity, cancel the prior timer and persist only the latest text once the trailing timer fires.
Maintain independent pending autosave state per document so navigation between documents neither combines their edits nor redirects a delayed write.
Preserve pending document persistence across existing navigation and editor retirement: selecting another document or closing the editor must not implicitly cancel the per-document pending save.
Preserve Store::write semantics: when the delayed save occurs, it updates the addressed record, increments revision, synchronously notifies subscribed integrations, and returns the event as before.

Preserve current navigation behavior, including document retirement/output, synchronous opening and reading, visit numbering, projection commit/clear behavior, and retained projection breadcrumb trail.
Leave Preview unchanged, including its separate 40 ms trailing timing and hide() cancellation.

ordering_barriers: Within Trailing::push, any prior handle is cancelled before the latest pending value is installed and a replacement 120 ms timer is scheduled.
When the autosave timer fires, the pending value is cleared from the trailing task before its work callback invokes the store write.
A delayed save writes to Store before Store synchronously invokes saved-integration listeners for that event.
Workspace::select retains the existing sequence: allocate epoch/visit, open the editor and emit the document, then commit and publish the projection breadcrumb.
Workspace::close retains the existing sequence: advance epoch, close/retire the editor and emit a null document, then clear and publish projection selection.

Navigation triggered synchronously by a Store::write listener is allowed to complete during the delayed save notification; the autosave callback must not subsequently apply stale navigation or projection state.
preservation: Existing public Workspace methods and their observable shapes remain: select(id), edit(text), close(), selection(), and dispose().
A selected document is still read from Store and emitted with id, visit, and text when opened.
Badge subscription and detachment behavior remains tied to the active document view.
Projection commit still appends each selected visit to trail; clear removes only selected and retains the breadcrumb archive.
Store revision numbering and synchronous listener notification remain unchanged.
Per-document buffers continue to be retained by BufferBank and reused by document identifier.
Search preview remains an adjacent, independent transient consumer.
scope: Modify only editor autosave business behavior in /workspace/src/workflow.php.
Use the existing Trailing and BufferBank facilities for the editor's 120 ms per-document coalescing where appropriate.
Preserve the surrounding Store, navigation, projection, visit, and preview contracts unless the minimal autosave wiring requires interaction with them.
